limits: A new biochemical source is not a new independent sequence. Audit every observed protein against actual HMM full/core training inputs, both L4 banks, identity prototypes and the frozen identity corpus before annotation.
MALDI-TOF identified four proteins. HydD was not detected, but its absolute membership is unresolved; do not score its possible presence as a proven false positive.
A complete inferred complex must not be graded correct merely because its protein set includes three observed Hyd proteins. Report observed-member coverage and extra inferred members separately.
H2/NAD/Fd reaction evidence needs the observed HydABC; formate-linked reactions additionally need the observed FdhA. Untested reaction directions and NADP specificity are ungraded.
Cross-bin routing is a synthetic ownership boundary with the FdhA assigned to a distinct bin/contig; it must not yield a formate-linked hydrogenase reaction.
All uncharacterized genome proteins are ungraded. No template, threshold, active-site or reaction assignment is trained on this case.
